agent: Codex main session with two read-only MiniMax M3.1 Flash CCR workers
purpose: Correct hardware planning to a cloud-capability-first policy, assess VOID NVFP4 QAT feasibility, and establish benchmark anti-leakage rules.

policy_correction.rule: Heavy model work is planned against arbitrary cloud hardware and software. Locally attached GPUs are never used as a feasibility ceiling, speed ceiling, memory ceiling, or comparison baseline.
policy_correction.reason: NVFP4 QAT and video-diffusion finetuning require selecting a target numerical format and runtime first, then provisioning the matching on-demand cloud environment.
policy_correction.durable_change: AGENTS.md now records the cloud-capability-first and benchmark-role-separation contracts.

evidence: official paired-data trainer with rgb_full, rgb_removed, quadmask, background caption, and optional warped noise
VAE and T5 are frozen while the transformer is trainable
default Pass 1 recipe trains all transformer modules and uses DeepSpeed ZeRO-2
Pass 2 has a separate warped-noise fine-tuning script
void_transformer.conclusion: VOID adaptation is materially more direct than SAM 3.1 multiplex adaptation.

sam3_image_model.conclusion: A viable route for affected-region noun/mask adaptation, but it is not the SAM 3.1 multiplex video model.

sam31_multiplex.conclusion: Text/point/box conditioning is available, but direct mask conditioning and an official multiplex video fine-tuning recipe are absent. A four-class quadmask head would require new architecture and target handling.

nvfp4_qat_feasibility.verdict: Plausible and precedented, but not available by simply enabling a flag in the pinned VOID checkout.

existing_machinery.name: TorchAO NVFP4 QAT
facts: NVFP4FakeQuantizedLinear performs an NVFP4 forward and a dequantized/fake-quantized backward
prepare converts eligible nn.Linear modules and convert emits the target quantized model
activation and weight configs must both be supplied; weight-only NVFP4 QAT is explicitly unsupported
the current implementation is Blackwell-oriented and has no pre-Blackwell emulation guarantee

existing_machinery.name: TorchAO QAT workflow
facts: QATConfig supports NVFP4DynamicActivationNVFP4WeightConfig as a base config
prepare inserts fake quantization and convert applies the deployment format after training
static activation calibration exists for Intx affine QAT, not the NVFP4 path

existing_machinery.name: NVIDIA ModelOpt
facts: provides NVFP4 fake-quantization kernels and diffusion presets
supports learnable scale/amax methods and SVDQuant-style low-rank outlier handling in external recipes

existing_machinery.name: QVGen
facts: uses auxiliary error modules with rank decay so they do not remain at inference

trainability.weights: Eligible transformer Linear weights can receive straight-through/fake-quant gradients and become robust to NVFP4 rounding.
trainability.block_scales: The E4M3 16-element block scales are generally computed from weights; ModelOpt-style learnable amax/LSQ is an external route for making scale parameters trainable.
trainability.activation_global_scale: TorchAO NVFP4 QAT computes the per-tensor activation scale from runtime amax rather than training it as a parameter. QAT can make weights robust to that dynamic behavior.
trainability.activation_block_scales: The public TorchAO NVFP4 path computes activation block scales dynamically, not through a learned observer.

environment_boundary.pinned_void: PyTorch 2.7.1 and its custom CogVideoX loader/trainer.
environment_boundary.qat_lane: A separate modern Blackwell-capable PyTorch/TorchAO or ModelOpt research lane is required. The exact runtime is selected by the pinned QAT implementation and native kernel requirements, not by any local machine.
environment_boundary.checkpoint_boundary: The BF16 teacher/reference remains in the pinned VOID environment; the QAT lane exports an artifact only after parity and quality gates pass.

recommended_qat_sequence: Provision an on-demand Blackwell-class cloud lane matching the selected TorchAO/ModelOpt commit; do not use spot/preemptible capacity for a training run.
Establish a BF16 cloud teacher baseline on fixed generated train/calib/dev splits.
Measure NVFP4 PTQ with trimmed, timestep-aware activation statistics before spending on QAT.
If PTQ misses quality, run transformer-only NVFP4 QAT on eligible Linear layers while keeping norms, patch/projection sensitivity tests, VAE, and T5 outside the low-bit target.
Add scale learning or an SVDQuant/QVGen-style low-rank auxiliary branch only after plain NVFP4 QAT is attributed layer-by-layer.
Add Q-VDiT-style temporal distillation if temporal consistency remains the dominant regression.
Convert, export, and serve in a separate inference lane; compare against the BF16 teacher on identical seeds and inputs.

training_design.target_modules: CogVideoXBlock attention projections and feed-forward Linear layers are the first target set; patch embedding and output projection require separate sensitivity gates.
keep_high_precision: T5 unless a separate encoder PTQ experiment proves a benefit
training_design.timestep_sampling: Use the actual inference schedules and stratified high/mid/low-noise bins; training's uniform 1000-bin sampler alone does not guarantee coverage of the 30-step Pass 1 or 50-step Pass 2 schedules.
training_design.cfg_branches: Calibrate and evaluate Pass 1 CFG-off separately from Pass 2 CFG-on.
training_design.passes: Train or calibrate Pass 1 and Pass 2 as separate distributions and checkpoints.
training_design.teacher: Use a frozen same-weight BF16 teacher for velocity/output distillation and temporal diagnostics.

quality_gates: per-layer output error and activation-scale error against the BF16 teacher
quadmask class fidelity and affected-region false-positive regression
Pass 1 versus Pass 2 temporal stability and flicker
fixed-seed output digests, median/p95 latency, peak memory, and cloud cost

license_does_not_prevent_leakage.finding: CC BY-NC may reduce incidental commercial redistribution, but it is not a split rule and does not remove public test annotations.
license_does_not_prevent_leakage.stronger_rule: The SAM 3 paper explicitly states that its benchmark is for model evaluation and should not be used for training.
license_does_not_prevent_leakage.commercial_boundary: NC-licensed media is especially unsuitable for client-facing training; use generated or commercially licensed data for client adaptations.

sam_co_state: Gold, Silver, and VEval annotation repositories use SAM License terms rather than a blanket CC BY-NC term.
SA-V and YT-Temporal VEval media are packaged CC-BY-NC 4.0; SmartGlasses media are CC-BY-4.0.
Gold/Silver/VEval test annotations are public after gated access; there is no hidden submission server.
Public benchmark media overlap concerns exist because SAM 3 reports in-domain training pools and evaluation domains from related sources.
corpus_roles: calib: quantization activation statistics, expert calibration, thresholds, and prompt selection only
dev: repeated model selection and ablations only
hard_rules: No eval artifact may enter any training, QAT, expert-calibration, prompt-tuning, ensemble-weight, or hyperparameter-search input.
Splits are by source asset or source sequence, never by frame or generated clip.
Every row records dataset/source revision, license, intended role, access date, file digest, and derived-artifact digest.
Before fitting, perform media-level deduplication against eval and lockbox using sampled-frame hashes/perceptual hashes and embeddings.
Kubric generation pins the generator revision, GSO asset-list digest, asset split, camera/physics seeds, and zero asset-ID intersection across roles.
HUMOTO splits by original motion sequence and requires its external access/license terms.
YouTube-derived benchmarks are pinned by extracted-frame digests because video re-download can shift frames.
Scores on public test annotations are labeled offline test-set measurements, not untouched generalization claims.
benchmark_hygiene.generated_benchmark: Build the primary clean benchmark from newly generated Kubric counterfactual pairs with disjoint asset IDs and a separately generated lockbox. Treat it as a reimplementation, not as Netflix's unreleased paper benchmark.

worker_evidence.parent_validation: Parent directly verified TorchAO NVFP4FakeQuantizedLinear/QAT workflow and VOID's transformer-only training/freezing behavior from public source and pinned checkout.

No QAT implementation was added to samurai or to the pinned VOID checkout.
TorchAO, ModelOpt, QVGen, Q-VDiT, SVDQuant, and DeltaQuant findings are source/public-document evidence, not local execution results.

The exact cloud GPU vendor, region, instance count, and modern QAT runtime remain an implementation decision gated by live capability and cost probes.
CC BY-NC or SAM License terms do not authorize client-facing reuse by themselves; each source's actual terms must be reviewed before commercial adaptation.
